descricao_original: Epithelial invaginations into the lamina propria of the small intestine form the intestinal glands, also known as the glands or crypts of Lieberkuhn. The bases of these glands extend down to the muscularis mucosae. Intestinal glands contain goblet cells, absorptive cells, Paneth cells, enteroendocrine (DNES) cells and stem cells. 400x
